description: Draft a public reply (and, on Instagram, a DM) for one comment on the account's own post (from comments_recent). Waits on Today and Inbox for a person's tap, like a suggested auto-reply; nothing is sent by this call. The comment is read back from the network, so pass only its id. One answer per comment, within 7 days of it. Keep the brand's voice, answer the question, and in a DM say it's an automated message when it is one.

dm.description: Instagram only: a private reply (DM); {name} becomes the commenter's username

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

reply.description: Public reply under the comment; {name} becomes the commenter's username (TikTok 150 characters, Bluesky 300, Threads and Mastodon 500, Instagram 2,200)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
